Nmap service detection shows Apache httpd 2.4.7 on port 80 and OpenSSH 6.6.1p1 on port 22. WhatWeb confirms Apache 2.4.7 and reveals additional headers. Nikto scanning on port 80 identified a missing X-Frame-Options header, indicating a clickjacking risk, and no other critical misconfigurations. No critical CVEs were triggered, but the exposed Apache and SSH versions could be targeted by known exploits. Recommendations: remove version disclosure from the Server header, enable security headers including X-Frame-Options and HSTS, consider upgrading Apache and OpenSSH to patched versions, block or restrict non‑essential services such as the Nping echo service, and enforce a firewall to allow inbound traffic only on required ports.
